name: Deposits
notes: Refundable deposits (utility or lease); never an expense

name: Furniture & equipment
notes: Capital purchases above the business's capitalization threshold

name: Leasehold improvements
notes: Build-out and improvements to the space

name: Service charges retained
notes: Only the part the house keeps (not tips paid out)

name: Discounts & comps
notes: Contra revenue: entered as negative sales

name: Cost of goods sold
notes: Parent of all COGS (inventory method: begin + purchases - end)

name: Wine
notes: Wine, sake, vermouth by the bottle if the business counts it as wine

name: Bar mix
notes: Everything that goes in a drink that is not alcohol

name: Mixers & syrups
notes: Tonic, soda, juices, purees, syrups, bitters

name: N/A beverages
notes: Bottled and canned soft drinks, water, energy drinks, N/A beer and spirits

name: Fountain drinks
notes: Bag-in-box syrup and fountain CO2 billed with it

name: Benefits
notes: Health, retirement, staff meals if tracked here

name: Bar supplies
notes: Bar tools, picks, pour spouts, bar mats

name: Music & entertainment
notes: DJs, bands, music licensing and streaming

name: Equipment repair
notes: Refrigeration, ice machine, draft system, kitchen equipment

name: Card processing fees
notes: Only when not netted from reported sales

name: Rewards & loyalty program
notes: Program cost, not the redeemed value (that is 4900-30)

name: Other income & expense
notes: Below the line: not in operating profit
